Sound familiar?

Every department has a reason it isn't theirs.

Money leaks in the gaps between teams, and nobody owns the gap. In a recent engagement with a large regional enterprise, I sat down with every department and heard the same story eleven times.

Sales blames supply chain.Supply chain blames planning, planning blames finance, finance blames IT.
Three versions of the forecast.Each one protects a different team.
Orders raised against stock that isn't there.Nobody can name which product earns the company the most.
A system migration on unmapped processes.The technology plan is ahead of the ownership plan.

That is a mutiny without a captain. Read the full story →

The test every AI agent must pass

Four conditions before any agent touches live operations.

In a recent diagnosis I tested eight agentic AI use cases against them. None was blocked by the technology. Two could start immediately, five were waiting on a definition or a decision, and one was waiting on data nobody had released. The constraint was leadership.

03

04

FAQ

Questions leaders ask first.

What is the AI Weak-Link Diagnostic?

A fixed-fee, two-week diagnosis of a business. I interview each department, test what people tell me against your own data, put a number in AED on the money leaking between departments, score your AI use cases, and hand your leadership team a 100-day plan.

Who is it for?

CEOs, CFOs, COOs and heads of transformation at UAE and GCC businesses with several departments, a planned system migration or AI ambitions, and a suspicion that problems keep landing between teams. It fits retail, distribution, FMCG, logistics, manufacturing and portfolio companies best.

How long does it take and what does it cost?

Two weeks from kickoff to a 45-minute board or CEO readout. The fee is fixed and agreed up front. The Weak-Link Diagnostic is from AED 20,000, and a 5-day Executive AI Readiness Review for a single function is from AED 7,500. I take 3 engagements per quarter.

Do I need to buy AI software or a build afterwards?

No. The diagnosis stands on its own. If it shows a use case that is safe to start, I can scope a 60-day proof of concept, but you are never obliged to continue.

What do you need from us?

Access to each department head for one interview, a read-only extract of the relevant operational or transaction data, and a named executive sponsor. I sign an NDA first, and any case study I publish is anonymised.

What are the four conditions before an AI agent goes live?

The data exists and is reachable. The terms it acts on are defined. A named business owner signs the boundary it operates within. It does not depend on a system migration. In a recent engagement, none of the eight use cases tested was blocked by the technology.

Is this different from a typical AI strategy engagement?

Yes. Most start with the technology. This starts with ownership and the data you already hold, because agentic AI exposes weak ownership fast. An agent put on a blame culture runs the confusion at machine speed.
